# EngCoder EpochGui provenance

EngCoder vendors only the backend-neutral EpochGui library. The source was
copied without Epoch editor, renderer, runtime, project, or generated files.

- EpochGui version: 0.89.30
- Owning Epoch worktree commit: e974921622643e796be134b356f9ca4f4137f811
- Exact EpochGui subtree tree: 191badda3412f195b4a1cfc635b05b2f3df9584c
- Last commit changing the subtree: 261f7fff8473432bba8a948d14988dba290329cf
- License: LicenseRef-MIT-NoSell (preserved in LICENSE)

The vendored `191badda3412f195b4a1cfc635b05b2f3df9584c` subtree is the
EpochGui authority for this EngCoder release. EngCoder does not claim here
that a separately hosted standalone EpochGui repository currently has an
identical tree; that identity was not reverified for this release. The
upstream README is retained as source documentation and does not override
this release-specific provenance record.

EpochGui owns reusable layout, state, input, and geometry calculations.
EngCoder continues to own Win32 windows, event translation, painting, text
shaping, native commands, and presentation.
